regressions.title: Integration tests intermittently fail: 'entry point exited without ever building an IHost'
regressions.detail: Two root causes: (1) Coverlet instrumented referenced DLLs into %TEMP% and raced WebApplicationFactory host build; (2) ExceptionMiddlewareTests used IClassFixture OUTSIDE [Collection], so its factory ran in PARALLEL with the collection and raced the static HostFactoryResolver listener — a different test lost the race each run.
regressions.fix: Removed RunSettingsFilePath (Coverlet) from the integration csproj + added [assembly: CollectionBehavior(DisableTestParallelization=true)]. Verified 28/28 across repeated runs.

regressions.title: Testcontainers referenced but not used; Azurite lifecycle is manual
regressions.detail: DotNet.Testcontainers is a PackageReference in the integration csproj, but CustomWebApplicationFactory probes a pre-started Azurite via TcpClient 127.0.0.1:10002 and falls back to NSubstitute mocks. The running container (poredoimage-azurite-dev) is not solution-named and is started outside the test process — violates 'manage the Azurite lifecycle strictly using Testcontainers, zero manual cleanup'.
regressions.fix: Introduce a Testcontainers Azurite fixture in the collection that starts/stops the container per test session
